answer_1.quote: LLMs may provide a means for lay readers to access such findings by automatically summarizing and simplifying texts into plain language.
answer_1.outputs: plain language summaries of RCT abstracts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate a suite of existing automatic factuality metrics shown to perform well for factuality in summarization, as well as newly devised LLM-based evaluations.

answer_3.quote: Prior work has also shown that LLMs themselves can be good evaluators for factuality in summarization.
criteria: factuality with respect to PICO elements

answer_4.quote: FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are asked to provide a rating between 1 to 4 codifying the factuality with respect to each PICO element... and provide natural language rationales to justify their ratings.
